dek: The 2026 provisional register and the omissions list for the Rural Representative Election (RRE) were released today (August 21). Members of the public may log in to the RRE Voter Registration Information Enquiry System through the RRE website ( www.had.gov.hk/rre ) to check their own registration particulars, as well
